name: cucumber-jump-ext
description: Navigate between Gherkin .feature files and step definitions across Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, C#, Dart, and Go.
author: lntvan166

cucumberJump.projects.markdownDescription: Service packages: feature glob → bdd registry → step implementations. Matched first when resolving from a `.feature` file.

featureGlob.description: Glob relative to workspace folder, e.g. services/my-api/feature/**/*.feature. If several entries match the same file, the one whose bddFile lives under the same directory tree as the feature file’s package root (path before /feature/) is chosen.

bddFile.description: Optional. Path or glob to a Go BDD step registry file (e.g. bdd.go). Only required for the legacy Go godog StepMap pattern. Omit for all other languages — the adapter auto-detects step patterns from stepsGlob file extension.

stepsGlob.description: Glob for step definition files. The file extension determines the language: .java/.kt → Java/Kotlin, .py → Python, .ts/.js → JavaScript/TypeScript, .rb → Ruby, .cs → C#, .dart → Dart, .go → Go. The ** rule applies the same way as bddFile.

cucumberJump.includeStepRegistryInDefini.markdownDescription: When **false** (default), Go to Definition / Ctrl+click from `.feature` steps lists only the `*_steps.go` implementation when it resolves; if not, `bdd.go` is still offered. When **true**, the step registry line in `bdd.go` is also listed. Commands *Go to Step Registry* / *Go to Implementation* are unchanged.

cucumberJump.codeLensEnabled.markdownDescription: Show **Implementation** / **Registry** CodeLens on Gherkin step lines in `.feature` files.

cucumberJump.statusBarHintEnabled.markdownDescription: On `.feature` step lines, show the resolved implementation path in the status bar (debounced). Click opens **Show step resolution** output.

cucumberJump.devModeDebounceMs.markdownDescription: Delay (ms) before syncing the paired pane in **Dev mode** after cursor moves.

cucumberJump.notifyConflictingExtensions.markdownDescription: When **true** (default), show a one-time notice if another Cucumber/Gherkin extension is installed: VS Code **merges** all **Go to Definition** results on `.feature` steps, so Cucumber Jump cannot override Ctrl+click priority. Use **F12** (*Go to primary step target*) for this extension only, or **Disable (Workspace)** the other extension. Dismiss with *Don't show again* (stored globally).

cucumberJump.autoConfigure.markdownDescription: When **true** (default) and no `cucumberJump.projects`/`libraries` are configured, Cucumber Jump scans the workspace once and navigates using the detected projects (nothing is written to settings). Set **false** to disable inference.

cucumberJump.libraries.markdownDescription: Shared step libraries searched after the matching project (in array order).

bddFile.description: Optional. Path or glob to a Go BDD step registry file (e.g. bdd.go). Only required for the legacy Go godog StepMap pattern. Omit for all other languages — the adapter auto-detects step patterns from stepsGlob file extension.

stepsGlob.description: Glob for step definition files. Extension determines the language (same as cucumberJump.projects).
